finalText:
**Build's clean now.** Exit 0, 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- `resolveRetries` in [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- `isBackoffEnabled` in [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw whenever the flag was `undefined`. New config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now treats that as disabled.

Rest of the warnings are just deprecation/lint noise from the bumped deps, not bugs.

Next: nothing. Build passes clean.
